Name: Wildflower Grass Field
Author: DustBeauty
Description:
Adds a total of 52 new grass+flower variations for 4 seasons. To achieve a natural-looking grass field.

Content Pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url]﻿.
Best match with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4705]Stardew Foliage Redone - A Nature Toned Map Recolour[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone - Foliage Only[/url]﻿.


[b]Each season comes with 13 different grass types, including winter grasses.[/b]
[b]To remove certain grass type[/b], you only need to [u]delete its png file[/u] in its season's folder.
[b]To increase the spawn rate of certain grass type[/b], you can [u]duplicate its png file[/u] in its season's folder.


Fully compatible and works well with SVE, SVR/SVR2, Reset Terrain Features, and other mods that change the grass growth rate.
Compatible with winter grass but makes it obsolete.
Compatible with other grass recolours but makes them obsolete.

________________________________________________________________________
Huge thanks to Andy([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48334523?tab=user+files]EpicBellyFlop45[/url]) for being a wish granting wizard!
Some grasses are edited based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1235]Eemie's Wildflowers[/url]﻿.

Downloads.Description: Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url], put it in your Mods folder along with this mod.
